description: DaCe GPT integrates large language models into the DaCe framework to enhance performance optimization in scientific computing applications.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Principal investigator of the DaCe GPT project.

funding_summary: The project received up to €150,000 in funding over a period of up to 18 months from the ERC Proof-of-Concept Grant.
inflection_why_now: The increasing complexity of hardware accelerators necessitates advanced optimization techniques to maintain efficiency in scientific simulations.
devils_advocate_risks: Integrating large language models into existing scientific computing frameworks may present unforeseen technical challenges.
Researchers without expertise in high-performance computing might face difficulties adopting the new optimization tools.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: SAP's expertise in enterprise software and data management aligns with DaCe GPT's focus on optimizing performance in scientific computing applications.
Evonik's interest in innovative technologies and materials could complement DaCe GPT's advancements in computational optimization for scientific simulations.
